items.title: GTA VI-Themed Beer Labels Clear US Approval - Pißwasser, Patriot and No Mames Vice City
items.summary: Pißwasser, finally legal. Don't drink and drive, in real life or in Leonida.
items.body: Tripping Animals Brewing's GTA VI-themed beer labels, Pißwasser, Patriot and No Mames Vice City, have cleared approval from the US Alcohol and Tobacco Tax and Trade Bureau. The brewery has not said whether the beers will reach shelves.
items.x_post_text: GTA VI-themed beer labels - Pißwasser, Patriot, No Mames Vice City - cleared US federal approval for Tripping Animals Brewing. Shelf date unknown. #GTA6 #GTAVI

items.title: Rockstar Lets Journalists Watch an Unscripted 90-Minute GTA 6 Session - Map Said to Match GTA 4, GTA 5 and RDR2 Combined
items.summary: Rockstar finally lets people watch the game being played. A map the size of three games and cops who read your outfit: plan your disguises.
items.body: Rockstar invited journalists into its studio for an unscripted session in which the head of development played GTA 6 for about 90 minutes. Reports from the session say the map is roughly the size of GTA 4, GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2 combined, and that police track players based on their descriptions, so a quick outfit change matters more than it used to. These are accounts from the people in the room; Rockstar has not published its own breakdown. Launch is November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S.
items.x_post_text: Rockstar let journalists watch ~90 unscripted minutes of #GTA6: a map reportedly the size of GTA 4, GTA 5 and RDR2 combined, and cops who track you by your description. Change your shirt, Lucia. #GTAVI #Rockstar

items.title: Gesaffelstein and Justice Team Up on a GTA 6 Track - A 50-Track Soundtrack Is Coming in December
items.summary: Two French electronic heavyweights, one midnight drop. Vice City's soundtrack just got expensive.
items.body: Gesaffelstein and Justice collaborated on a GTA 6 track that went live at midnight local time on October 29. Pre-orders for a 50-track soundtrack are due in December. Justice composed the game's original score and also wrote the single that debuted in the launch trailer.
items.x_post_text: Gesaffelstein x Justice just dropped a #GTA6 track at midnight local time, with pre-orders for a 50-track soundtrack coming in December. Headphones on, wanted level off. #GTAVI #Justice

items.title: Insider: Rockstar Is Sending GTA 6 Review Codes, Embargo Lifts November 18
items.summary: Review codes are out. Pick a side now: believe the scores or the vibes.
items.body: Insider NateTheHate2 reports that Rockstar has started sending out GTA 6 review codes and that the review embargo lifts on November 18, a day before launch. Rockstar has not confirmed the date, so treat it as an insider report.
items.x_post_text: Insider NateTheHate2 says Rockstar has started sending #GTA6 review codes, with the embargo lifting November 18. Not confirmed by Rockstar. Get ready for the review-score discourse. #GTAVI

items.title: GTA 6 Reportedly Takes Up 210 GB on PS5, According to PlayStation Network Database Tracker
items.summary: 210 GB: that's your whole SSD, and the game isn't even out yet.
items.body: A PlayStation Game Size tracker account on X reported that GTA 6 takes up 210 GB on PS5, a figure it says it spotted in the PlayStation Network database. Rockstar and Sony have not confirmed the number, and install sizes can change before launch. Clear some space.
items.x_post_text: A PlayStation Game Size tracker reports #GTA6 at 210 GB on PS5, spotted in the PSN database. Unconfirmed, sizes can change. Start deleting that backlog now. #GTAVI #PS5

items.title: South Park Shows GTA 6 Footage in a New Episode - Rockstar Credited at the End
items.summary: Vice City's biggest star this week: a cartoon from Colorado. Yes, the dog poop scene is canon.
items.body: A new South Park episode included GTA 6 footage, with a scene of Jason hitting a passerby with dog poop. Rockstar is credited at the end of the episode, which points to an authorized crossover rather than a leak.
items.x_post_text: South Park just aired #GTA6 footage - Jason hitting a passerby with dog poop - and Rockstar is credited at the end. Marketing in 2026 is a wild place. #GTAVI #SouthPark

items.title: Circana Analyst: Publishers Overestimate How Much GTA 6 Will Dominate Player Attention
items.summary: Everyone is panicking about the GTA 6 shadow. One analyst says calm down. Good luck with that.
items.body: Circana's Mat Piscatella said publishers are overestimating how much GTA 6 will dominate players' attention. It is one analyst's view, but it comes as other publishers adjust their release plans around the November 19 launch.
items.x_post_text: Circana's Mat Piscatella says publishers overestimate how much #GTA6 will dominate player attention. Everyone else is still moving release dates anyway. #GTAVI

items.title: GameSir Unveils Two GTA 6-Styled G7 Pro Controllers - Without a Rockstar License
items.summary: Neon colors, zero permission from Rockstar. The unofficial merch economy is alive.
items.body: GameSir showed two G7 Pro controllers styled after GTA 6, with sales starting in November. The company has no Rockstar license or partnership for them, so these are unofficial products inspired by the game.
items.x_post_text: GameSir unveiled two #GTA6-styled G7 Pro controllers, on sale in November. No Rockstar license or partnership though, so these are unofficial. Check twice before you buy. #GTAVI

items.title: Virgin Media Ireland Offers EUR 100 an Hour to Play GTA 6 - Applications Close November 15
items.summary: Paid to play GTA 6. You know a dream job when you see the application deadline.
items.body: Virgin Media Ireland is looking for a winner to play GTA 6 for EUR 100 per hour, with a free copy, in exchange for an honest opinion posted on social media. Applications close November 15.
items.x_post_text: Virgin Media Ireland will pay one winner EUR 100 an hour to play #GTA6, plus a free copy, for honest opinions on social media. Applications close November 15. Dream job found. #GTAVI

items.title: Burger Shot and Cluckin' Bell Signs Show Up at Miami's Kaseya Center
items.summary: Fast food from a fictional state, now in a real arena. Hold the cholesterol.
items.body: Burger Shot and Cluckin' Bell signage now appears at Miami's Kaseya Center as part of Rockstar's real-world marketing. GTA 6 launches November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S.
items.x_post_text: Burger Shot and Cluckin' Bell signs are now up at Miami's Kaseya Center as part of Rockstar's #GTA6 marketing push. Vice City cuisine, IRL. #GTAVI #Miami
